notes: Round 10 (scratch_r3, stopped at 780k of 1.33M decisions when Paul asked for the 80M walkers' last checkpoints under the minds): the hunt grows. Wounds dealt 0.63 to 3.8 healths a summary, kills 1 to 1.8 in the summaries that have some, speed 0.52 to 0.89 of a walk speed, Attack mode 40%. Eating begins: feeding 0.03% to 0.28% of the time, the eat term ten times up, gnaw paying for the first time. 95% still starve after 224 s. Round 11, first round of the line scratch80 (walkers from the 80M trainings at 65M, minds from scratch_r3): the meal pays half as much again, nothing else touched while eating is being found.

terms.name: gnaw
terms.expr: 0.15 * step(0.95 - energy) * mode_feed * step(2.5 - carcass_distance) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
